I believe that after understanding the basics of the language, students learn best by learning a language in context. In other words, after attaining a basic understanding of reading, writing, listening and speaking, it is best for students to continue their learning journey based on topics that interest them.

As a result, I like to make classes personal and tailor-made to the student's interests and needs. I encourage the student to speak as much as they can. I listen and take notes. And then, I model another version of the same idea with corrections in pronunciation, pacing and/or more frequently used language elements. Students are then encouraged to emulate to the best of their ability.

pro_course_detail.description: Individualized conversation with correction adapted to your needs using a variety of media according to your liking​ and wishes.  I work a lot with pronunciation, helping you to be understood better.  I help  you to  understand the American accent where we drop letters and blend the words together, thus making your comprehension better since the way we speak on an everyday basis is very different from the way we write. I make a lot of corrections during the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Professional
pro_course_detail.description: A1 to C2 All areas of interest  I suggest that a student takes a conversation class for the 1st class so we can talk about your level and what you want to focus on and then start with the professional classes if that is what you are interested in.
